basics.name: Gabo Rodriguez
basics.label: Senior Application Security Engineer
basics.summary: Cybersecurity specialist focused on application security, cloud IAM and DevSecOps. I implement and operate identity and access controls across AWS and Azure — roles, policies, service accounts and short-lived credentials via STS — to cut reliance on static secrets and make access auditable. I integrate IAM, secrets management and security tooling into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code, so validation and enforcement run automatically instead of by hand.
